as_of: Sep 10 2026 18:15 PT / Sep 11 01:15 UTC — 早盘预览 (overnight). US closed a fourth straight down session as Brent spiked toward $109 and the 10Y held above 4.9% (highest since 2023). Bessent's beefed-up Treasury buyback failed to calm markets; Fed-hike odds jumped ahead of Friday's CPI. Oracle beat on cloud; Adobe disappointed.

indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: S&P 500 closed 7,636.36, -0.48% Thu Sep 10 — a fourth consecutive losing session, breaking key support as Treasury yields spiked and crude surged. Energy bid, broad multiples pressured by rates.

indices.name: 道琼斯
indices.note: Dow closed 52,380.66, -0.77% (-405 pts). Rate-sensitive industrials hit hardest by the oil-shock inflation narrative and multiyear-high yields.

indices.name: 纳斯达克
indices.note: Nasdaq Composite closed 26,253.34, -0.64%. Long-duration tech pressured by yields; Oracle's earnings beat/cloud optimism and BofA's 'yields aren't a threat to AI yet' note provide partial offsets.

indices.name: 恒生指数
indices.note: HSI closed 24,954.47, -1.27% Thu Sep 10 — tracking the global risk-off and oil spike; H-share tech the relative laggard.

indices.name: 日经225
indices.note: Nikkei 225 65,270.95, +0.20% — resilient despite the global risk-off; yen and JGB long-end (20Y ~3.7%+) remain the cross-market watch items.

indices.name: KOSPI
indices.note: KOSPI 7,033.92, -0.25% Thu Sep 10 — holding above 7,000 after a strong multi-week rally; still Asia's key risk gauge into the tech/oil backdrop.

indices.name: 台湾加权
indices.note: TSEC weighted 46,940.49, -0.51% — semis soft as US tech leads the downside.

indices.name: 英国富时100
indices.note: FTSE 100 10,629.46, -0.38% — energy strength on crude partly offsets the broad risk-off.

indices.name: 德国DAX
indices.note: DAX 25,423.82, -0.60% — autos and rate-sensitive names lead losses amid EU tariff/trade friction.

indices.name: 法国CAC40
indices.note: CAC 40 8,126.94, -0.36% — luxury/autos soft; German 10Y issuance at 2010-high yields adds duration pressure.

crypto.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
crypto.note: BTC ~$76,900 (-3.4% 24h, OKX/CoinGecko). Risk-off drag from rising real yields and the oil/inflation shock; 24h low ~$76.7k. Friday CPI is the key catalyst.

crypto.name: Ethereum (ETH)
crypto.note: ETH ~$2,418 (-3.84% 24h), held near $2.5k support; CPI on Friday is the next catalyst for a range break ($2,431–$2,600).

brent_crude.note: CRITICAL — Brent jumped toward $109 (FT: 'Global bond sell-off reignites as oil jumps to $109'), extending above $100 (last seen ~May/July) as the single largest cross-market driver, on US-Iran escalation, tanker strikes and Saudi output cuts amid Houthi threats.

wti_crude.note: WTI ~$100 (+4.13%), above the psychological $100 mark — supply-risk premium from US-Iran tanker strikes persists. Record-high diesel and rising gasoline are feeding the inflation narrative.

gold.note: COMEX gold ~$4,395 (-0.46%), softer as rising real yields and a firm dollar offset the safe-haven bid. Still elevated on US-EU trust erosion.

us_10y_yield.note: US 10Y ~4.92%, ABOVE 4.9% — highest since 2023. Bessent's beefed-up buyback operation FAILED to calm the market (MarketWatch); Druckenmiller says US borrowing costs still 'a little low'. Global bond sell-off reignited by the oil jump.

macro.oil_iran_escalation: CRITICAL: US-Iran conflict persists — Brent toward $109 as the market braces for a prolonged Iran war. Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned Monday as part of the Iran strategy. Saudi Arabia cut output to its lowest this year on Houthi threats. Oil is the dominant global driver.
macro.ppi_hot: US PPI rose 0.4% m/m in August, as expected — but combined with oil >$100 it hardens the inflation narrative and stokes Fed-hike bets. Friday's CPI is 'even more important than usual.'
macro.us_10y_4p9: US 10Y yield tops 4.9% (highest since 2023) and holds above it after Bessent's buyback failed to calm markets. Full global bond sell-off reignited by the oil jump.
macro.fed_hike_bets: CRITICAL: 'The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher' (CNBC). Hawkish repricing driven by oil-led inflation + the PPI print; FOMC Sep 16 looms.
macro.us_futures: US equity futures little changed ahead of Friday's key CPI report (CNBC live update 01:03 UTC). Market is in a wait-and-see stance after four down sessions.
macro.asia_close: Asia Thu Sep 10: Nikkei +0.20% (65,271), KOSPI -0.25% (7,034, holding >7,000), TSEC -0.51%, HSI -1.27% (24,954). Broadly defensive on oil/rates.
macro.crypto_riskoff: Crypto tracking the broader risk-asset softness: BTC -3.4% (~$76.9k), ETH -3.84% (~$2,418). Nasdaq investing $100M in Kraken parent Payward for tokenized stocks — a structural adoption note.
macro.earnings: Oracle's AI bet paid off — cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubled, rosier forecast, stock edged up after hours. Adobe's latest earnings 'leave Wall Street wanting more' (MarketWatch).
macro.china_tech: CNBC: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says — fresh US-China AI friction. Apple's $1,999 foldable 'iPhone Duo' enters China's crowded foldable market facing a price test. FT debates 'Is now really the time to worry about a new China shock?'
macro.trade_war: US import ban on a slew of Canadian goods; Canada's retaliatory tariffs (CA$27.6bn) in effect — trade friction adds to the inflation/rates backdrop. Trump's $1tn+ 'dividend' plan met bipartisan pushback.
macro.watch: Key watch items for the A-share open: 1) Brent toward $109 & US-Iran escalation; 2) US 10Y >4.9% (highest since 2023) & global bond sell-off; 3) Friday CPI + FOMC hike odds (Sep 16); 4) Fed hike-likelihood jump; 5) HSI -1.27% overnight drag on Hong Kong; 6) crypto -3–4% risk-off; 7) Oracle/Adobe earnings read-through to AI complex.
